risk_if_not_implemented: Without Periodic Configuration Reviews, Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) may operate with insecure, unauthorized or drifted configurations that expand the attack surface. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unaddressed Security / Compliance Exposure (R-GV-2), Lack of oversight of internal controls (R-GV-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Baseline Configurations
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, document and maintain secure baseline configurations for Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) that are consistent with industry-accepted hardening standards.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Baseline Configurations (CFG-04) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Periodic Review (CFG-08) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Restrict Roles Permitted To Install Software
compensating_control_2.description: Automated mechanisms exist to prevent the installation of software, unless the action is performed by a privileged user or service.
compensating_control_2.justification: Restrict Roles Permitted To Install Software (CFG-12) provides access control enforcement that compensates for the absence of Periodic Review (CFG-08) by restricting system and data access to authorized users through alternative identity and access mechanisms. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
